engine.name: calibrated
engine.label: Calibrated model
engine.note: Trained on household state, product and store condition (weeks 27–44), isotonic-calibrated on real purchases in weeks 45–47

definitions.units: Visits that bought this product (how many items per visit is not counted)
definitions.expected_units: Sum of the probabilities over every decision
definitions.simulated_units: The day-by-day record actually rolled with draw 0. The sample visits and the 3D replay read this record
definitions.mc_p05_p95: 5–95% range over 200 draws. It captures only the luck of which customers buy, not the error of the model itself
definitions.revenue: Visits with a sale × the median pre-discount price of each product (USD)
definitions.same_luck: Every plan uses the same visits and the same random number per (visit, product, draw)
